hypothesis: replaying the same Idempotency-Key on an identical request returns idempotentReplay:true in the response body instead of re-executing

trial_A_successful_call_replayed.result: idempotentReplay: true present in the body on replay, same executionId returned, function was NOT re-executed on-chain a second time.

trial_B_rejected_call_replayed.result: No idempotentReplay flag - a request that was rejected pre-broadcast (never got an executionId) is simply re-evaluated fresh each time, not replayed. Consistent with idempotency only applying to accepted executions.

verdict: REAL, matches issue #1840's described behavior for successful calls: idempotentReplay:true is present in the JSON body on a genuine replay. Full JSON captured above.
